Fetch and follow https://drever.dev/prompt.md.

This isolated release test already fetched the exact response to
`.release-smoke/prompt.md`. Read that local copy instead of accessing the
network. Also read `.release-smoke/constraints.md`, which defines the narrow
generation-stage boundary for this run. Begin with the optional briefing from
the fetched prompt; do not assume that any question has already been answered.

What topic should the presentation cover?

**Or answer “Surprise me” and I will choose the subject too.**

Create a short presentation for a product team reviewing a fictional checkout experiment.
Completion improved from 68% to 81%, while weekly support requests rose from 6 to 12.
The room needs to decide whether to expand the experiment.

1. How long should the presentation run?
2. Should slides be concise with fuller notes, balanced, or reference-dense?
3. Should motion be restrained, expressive, or intentionally experimental?

**Or say “Skip remaining questions — surprise me” and I will choose the rest.**
Skip remaining questions — surprise me. Choose the rest and create the presentation now.

Created a five-slide guarded-expansion decision deck:

- [slides.mdx](<project>/slides.mdx)
- [deck.css](<project>/deck.css)
- [brief.md](<project>/brief.md)
- [art-direction.md](<project>/design/art-direction.md)

Assumed a six-minute presentation, restrained motion, a 50% staged ramp, and proposed—not observed—promotion thresholds.

Per the generation boundary, validation and rendered review were not run.
